about: Propiomazine 25 mg at night is supplied every month for eight months. The medicine has no Australian brand, so it appears by ingredient name.
Clomethiazole 192 mg capsules at night are supplied four times from January 2026 to April 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Zoloft (sertraline) is supplied monthly. Neither clomethiazole nor propiomazine is supplied.
